verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of a Stripe PM confirming that multi-currency subscriptions work by creating a separate plan per currency. That shows local-currency billing with per-currency price points, though via a manual plan-duplication approach. Nothing in the pack documents consolidated reporting converted to a home currency; the revenue-recognition and analytics items do not mention currency conversion. Missing for 10: first-party docs on multi-currency prices, evidence of home-currency consolidated reporting or FX conversion, and recent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency

citations.quote: Stripe PM confirmed you currently need to create a separate plan per currency (e.g. bronze_plan:eur)
